{{Cleanup}}{{Outdated}}
'''Bit Beasts''', known as {{Translation|'''Holy Beasts'''|聖獣|Seijū}} in Japan, are a recurring element in the classic ''Beyblade'' series. They are powerful monsters that inhabit the [[Bit Chips]] and [[Bit Protectors]] of [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblades]] and can be called upon into battle to assist their Bladers by empowering their Beys.

The exact nature of Bit-Beasts is vague, but some are depicted as gods or demigods, and their role in storylines has grown as the series progressed. They have been featured in the "''[[Beyblade (Anime)|Beyblade]]''", "''[[Beyblade: V-Force]]''", and "''[[Beyblade: G-Revolution]]''", as well as the "''[[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade|Beyblade]]''" and "''[[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade: Rising]]''" manga series, various video games, and the ''[[Beyblade Trading Card Game]]''.

==Information==
[[File:DragoonShot.jpg|thumb|200px|Dragoon, the main Bit-Beast of the original series]]

===Blader/Beyblade===
Many of the these ideals were not correctly portrayed in the English or worldwide released dubbed, and the true overall representation of a "Bit-Beast" was lost in translation. This led to the interpretation by overseas fans often being gravely misunderstood. This is partly owed to the English dub driving home the idea of the Bit-Beasts being "trapped" inside the Beyblade.

The Bit-Beasts or "Saint Beasts" overall represented the joint "Fighting Spirit" of Blader and Beyblade (in other words, it is an "avatar"). If the Beyblader proved their worth, the ancient Fighting Spirit would be drawn to them. That spirit then would reside within the Beyblade out of its own free will. Once the joint relationship of Blader and Beyblade was established, they would appear thereafter in any new Beyblade they used.

When the fighting spirit was strong, the Bit-Beast's spirit would influence the Beyblade, enhancing attack and signature moves. As demonstrated by Kai when he choose Dranzer's bit over Black Dranzer's, sacrificing one's soul for power can cost the Blader their soul. However, choosing one's heart over power can infuse a weaker Bit-beast with splendour the two have never demonstrated prior, even if the blader is doomed to lose the battle anyway.

By unleashing them, the flow of a battle can shift dramatically, even when the Beyblade parts haven't changed. It also expands the range of strategic possibilities. Because they represent the link between Blader and Beyblade, they are affected by a Blader's emotions and state of mind, mental distraction or physical conditions such as tiredness can impact them and affect the Beyblade in return, so focus is required to maintain the fighting spirit. Any distractions can lead to a disconnection between the fighting spirit and its Blader/Beyblader. When a Blader lost their Bit-beast, the Blader would have their own fighting spirit impacted, which is why many Bladers had periods of doubt after losing theirs.

FORTRESS DEFENSE!|Max commanding Draciel's special move}} '''Draciel''' is the '''Spirit of Water''', one of the four Sacred Bit-Beasts, and the Bit-Beast of [[Max Tate]]. ==Appearance and name== Draciel's appearance is of a giant, armored, black and purple-colored anthropomorphic turtle, modeled after the common or alligator snapping turtle in real life. Draciel's armor reflects Max's Beyblade, in that it's built for defense, like a turtle's shell. In keeping with the art style for the first season, Draciel was given a purplish-pink monochrome color, but reverted to the color scheme of its Bit-Chip appearance. Draciel is named after and based on one of the Four Saint Beasts in Chinese mythology; Draciel is modeled after Xuan Wu the Black Tortoise of the North and the Japanese name is "Genbu". When Draciel was added, he carried on the tradition of the name of the Bit-Beast after "dragon" and a military unit. In this case, it is from "Seal", which is a unit in the US Navy SEALs. ==Technique and attacks== [[File:Ezgif.com-gif-maker(1).gif|thumb|264x264px|Max using Draciel MS's special move: Aqua Shield]] Max and Draciel's technique is built around defense. Hence the beyblade also resembles a turtle shell, with ball bearings to increase defensive ability. In addition, Draciel can manipulate the water for special moves that range from offensive to defensive based on the beyblade version. Max's main strength is to withstand the special attacks of the other beybladers until their strength runs out. ==Anime== Draciel used to belong to Max's grandmother (in the dubbed version - in the original anime, it belonged to his [[Judy Tate|mother]]). When Max was 11, his father gave him Draciel in a pendant that belonged to Max's grandmother, before his match with Kai. During the second round of Max's battle with Kai, Max's beyblade bit chip was damaged due to the impact it received from Dranzer's [[Spin Fire|Spiral Survior]] attack, but not before it proceeded to shatter the pendant Max was wearing. Discovering Draciel, Max tried it on his beyblade and found it fit perfectly. Draciel then made his appearance in the third battle, battling Dranzer and ultimately losing, but Max was happy he finally had a bit beast of his own. Draciel

[[Dragoon V2 Wheel Xceed']] |Types=Attack |Elements=Wind |JpVoice=Takashi Matsuyama |FirstAppAnime=[[Beyblade - Episode 01|The Blade Raider]] |FirstAppManga=[[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade - Chapter 00|The Invincible Beyblader]]}} {{BeyQuotes|HYPER VICTORY TORNADO!|Tyson commanding Dragoon to use his special move|color=#36badf}} Dragoon is the '''Spirit of Wind''', one of the four sacred Bit-Beasts of legend, and is [[Tyson Granger|Tyson]]'s bit beast == Appearance == Dragoon has the appearance of a blue and turquoise anthropomorphic dragon. Physically, Dragoon has a long neck and tail, and can stand on two massive clawed feet. It has long arms ending in long claws that are similarly placed like human fingers. It has spikes running down from its head along its back and tail. Dragoon's spikes along its back and tail are the idea design for Dragoon's attack rings, which are always spiked in shape. Dragoon's design has changed from time to time in the original series. In the first season, Dragoon, along with the other Bit-Beasts, was designed to look like spirits, being given monochrome colors. In this, Dragoon's color was a light turquoise. In the second season, Dragoon was updated to look like its picture self when coming out of the Beyblade. In ''G-Revolution'', there were glimpses of Dragoon only during special attacks, sometimes interspersed with the shape of Dragoon being shown in its wind attack moves. Dragoon is modeled after Qing Long the Azure Dragon of the East and its Japanese name is "Seiryu". Like "Dranzer" "Dragoon" is a play on words, while "Dranzer" is a play on "Dragon" and "Panzer", "Dragoon" is a combination of "Dragon" and "Dragoon". Unlike Dranzer, his species did not change and all variations are dragons. == Power == [[File:Dragoon G Galaxy storm.gif|alt=|thumb|Dragoon G's special move, Galaxy Storm|362x362px]] Dragoon has command over the air, and thus can use a variety of wind based attacks. Most of the attacks involve generating huge tornadoes, that can blow away the opposing beyblade or can counter their attacks. Scientifically in the anime, these wind attacks were generated by Tyson's beyblade spinning so fast that it can manipulate the air around to create the tornadoes. Every one of Tyson's attacks with each beyblade was a version of using wind to create tornadoes. == Anime ==

FLAME SABRE!|Kai commanding Dranzer's special move}} Dranzer is the '''Spirit of Fire''', one of the four sacred bit-beasts, and the bit-beast of [[Kai Hiwatari|Kai]]. ==Appearance== Dranzer is modeled after Zhu Que the Vermilion Bird of the South and its Japanese name is "Suzaku". "Dranzer" comes from his Next Generation Beigoma Battle: Beyblade a main bit of Ultimate Frostic Dranzer which briefly appears in the manga. This is similar to Dragoon, who also gets his name from Tyson's main bit of the game Spin Dragoon. Dranzer has the appearance of a red and gold phoenix, with a flowing split tail and huge wings, It has gold and white armor around its chest, head and wings. In the original anime, keeping in line with the art style used, Dranzer was given a bright red monochrome color, reverting to its normal color scheme in the second season. Black Dranzer, an artificial version of Dranzer, was created in the same visual appearance, except the red was replaced by black. == Power and attacks == [[File:WearyMilkyEft-size restricted.gif|thumb|327x327px|Dranzer GT's special move, Blazing Gigs Tempest.]] Since Dranzer commands fire, all of its attacks are some variations of fire. Kai utilizes Dranzer's command over fire in a variety of weapons. Scientifically like Tyson's beyblade, Kai utilizes the friction in the air, and the contact with the opposing blades to use these fire attacks. Kai often utilizes a wide range of attack patterns, but historically, his usual method against weaker to normal opponents is to let them attack himself, wearing them out, or slowly feeding off their energy, and finish them off with a flourish. Against tougher opponents like Max, Ray and Tyson however, Kai abandons this method in favor of going all out against them, in the process showcasing his skill and tactical genius as a Beyblader. Dranzer draws power from Kai's Beyblade spirit, a combination of raw rage and inner emotions which he often channels into his Beyblading style. He considers himself a student of the sport, despite being one of the best beybladers of all time. == Anime == Dranzer, like Tyson's Dragoon, was in Kai's family since years, and is thought to have belonged to Kai's father. pages.title: Driger
pages.text:
'''Driger''' is the Thunder Spirit, one of the four sacred Bit-Beasts of legend, and the Bit-Beast of [[Ray Kon]].

[[File:Driger096.jpg|thumb|Driger as depicted in the anime]]

== Appearance ==
Driger is one of the four sacred Bit-Beasts, and based on the sacred White Tiger deity worshiped by the White Tiger Tribe ([[Fang Tribe]] in the manga series). It has the appearance of a muscular white tiger, with green stripes and armor resembling blades on its four legs and its head and an armored tail. As keeping in the style the Bit-Beasts were drawn in the original anime, Driger was given a monochrome bright green color, reverting to its picture appearance in the second season.

Driger's appearance contributes to Driger's Fang/claw style attack rings, which deal damage in swift barrages.

== Power and attacks ==
Driger commands the element of Thunder, and employs a range of attacks utilizing electricity based attacks that deal in swift and precise damage, complimenting Ray's beyblading style. Often the opponent's beyblade after being defeated shows signs of being mauled by a tiger. 

[[File:Gatling Claw.jpg|thumb|Driger G's attack, Gatling Claw]]

== Anime ==
Driger was worshiped by the White Tiger Tribe (Fang Tribe in the manga series). Driger was given to Ray by the head of the White Tiger Tribe, over his grandson [[Lee]], confirming that he would lead the White Tigers team. However, Ray left the village, with the intention of improving his beyblading skills, taking Driger with him. This act of betrayal would leave Lee and the White Tigers with a deep resentment, Lee in particular, given he viewed Ray as a brother and rival. Lee however let go of that resentment and appreciated Ray's skill after being defeated by Ray in the final match of the Asian Tournament, even going on to support him during the Bladebreakers' World Championship final match against the [[Demolition Boys]].

Ray lost Driger twice during the original series, first when Driger left his beyblade voluntarily when Ray lost his confidence, and second when Driger was sealed away by the Saint Shields, only to come back to Ray's beyblade, when they were battling the [[Saint Shields]] again.

== Trivia ==
* Ray often utilizes martial arts in his beyblading style, and Driger's attack pattern often mirrors that during their battles.

}}'''Venus''' is a Stamina Type [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] that uses the [[Magnacore System]]. It is [[Ming-Ming]]'s first Beyblade.

It was released by [[Takara]] as part of [[Random Booster 12]] on October 2, 2003 in Japan. [[Hasbro]] later released a variation of it, [[Venusian G]], sometime in 2004 internationally.

==Bit Chip (BC): Venus==
The chip depicts Venus.

==Attack Ring: Mirage Goddess==
*'''Attack:''' 1/4
*'''Defense:''' 2/4
*'''Endurance:''' 3/4

Mirage Goddess is a four-sided Attack Ring. Each side depicts the face of the winged cat, Venus, with a majestic motif all around. Several swirls over half-spheres appear as well. Each side uses stickers to create Venus' eyes, stickers for its beaks and additional stickers as wings; including the name "VENUS" on them. It is available in Beauty Pink, Sunlight Gold, Tide Blue and Anime Color versions.

==Weight Disk: Ten Heavy==
*'''Weight:''' 17 grams
*'''Attack:''' 1/4
*'''Defense:''' 3/4
*'''Endurance:''' 2/4

Ten Heavy, as its name suggests, is the largest in terms of weight of all Heavy Weight Disks.

==Blade Base: SG Sharp Base==
*'''Weight:''' 7 grams
*'''Attack:''' 2/4
*'''Defense:''' 2/4
*'''Endurance:''' 2/4

SG Sharp Base is a simple Blade Base. It is available in Beauty Pink, Sunlight Gold, Tide Blue and Anime Color versions.

==Spin Gear: NEO Right Spin Gear==
*'''Weight:''' 4 grams

The NEO Right Spin Gear is an upgrade to the original NEO Spin Gear. This version uses the Metal Weight Core. It is available in Beauty Pink, Sunlight Gold, Tide Blue and Anime Color versions.

==Recolors==
*'''Venus Beauty Pink Original Version''' - Light pink recolor. Takara exclusive to [[Random Booster 12]].
*'''Venus Sunlight Gold Original Version''' - Bright yellow recolor. Takara exclusive to Random Booster 12.
*'''Venus Tide Blue Original Version''' - Dark blue version. Takara exclusive to Random Booster 12.

==Variants==
*'''[[Venusian G]]''' - Red recolor with different parts. Released by [[Hasbro]] as a Starter Pack.
